notes.title: Space Boat Accessibility Update
notes.content:
Greetings Space travelers!

The latest Space Boat demo update is now live on Steam! We added several Accessibility features as well as quality of life improvements to this build. Since there seems to be a lot of interest in the details of what was done, I have put together a detailed list:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/7b57739370e18fd99453726d208145070cfeb879.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of life changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The controller navigation in the character creator UI is much improved. The controller highlight box now moves around how many people would expect it to.
[*] We added a new UI element that distinguishes pre-built suits (like the Pepper-oh-noes suit) from custom designed suits.
[*] We added a covert level indicator in the character creator that describes more clearly why the mission cannot start. This will also open gameplay possibilities as well as open the door for items that can improve your covert rating.
[*] The FBC race map now has improved collision and a new wider passthrough gate. It has been used to improve the flow of the track.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/5ac589949e6d3d208f5b296a1442397757b70d1a.png[/img]

[h2]Accessibility Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The pause menu is now available throughout the game (except during the chapter select screen which now has a similar menu with all the same features built-in). This change alone opened a number of bugs that have been addressed. I’ll spare you the details, but I think we can all agree that being able to change any settings or jump to any chapter at any moment is a win for everyone. 
[*] We finally added a Sound FX volume slider to our settings tab so that all sounds can now be adjusted by the player.
[*] We decided to keep the ambient music and game music on the same slider for streamers to easily mute out any song that is not our theme song and could lead to DMA strikes since some of our music might not be valid for streaming due to Premium Beat’s ever changing licensing agreements. Over the next year, we will be replacing all our licensed music to improve this situation.
[*] There’s been a lot of work done in the game for people with color blindness in the last year. For example, we added button prompts to what were originally just text color indicators. None the less, we have included the infamous color-blind shader option for the small minority of color-blind people that find it helpful. Please note that a lot of work is built into the art direction of the game, so this option is probably not necessary. The game was built to be color-blind friendly without it. 
[*] Mouse and controller sensitivity is now available. This is a win for everyone since not having it was an annoyance for many streamers as well.
[*] We added a framerate cap option for people who might need some processing power to go to another application other than the game (like OBS for example).
[*] We added an Auto-Run option to avoid having to hold the run button. Although running in Space Boat is not necessary, as a triple amputee myself, having to hold any button simultaneously in most games while operating other buttons is a quick way to get me to stop playing (although I have completed every Souls-Borne game there is). None the less, it is now an option which will at the very least, help players get through the electrified portion of the second chapter unscathed.
[*] We added an option for Single-Stick controls! Now you can walk and race without the need for two controller sticks. 
[*] Inverted controls was something that came up several times in the comments section. You can now switch it on here instead of having to go through any platform specific option.
[*] Finally, we added the option to toggle our subtitles. Previously they were always on, but now you can turn them off. These subtitles were designed for people with hearing impairments since they included descriptions of sounds.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/988f7f023340b882631921c6553b6d8c7767d800.gif[/img]

Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: Space Boat @ Steam's Next Fest Round 2!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/92a1b3654efe7a3ffbfe7e163b36b0e1bb03552d.png[/img]

Alright, let's do a final round of showcasing the new Space Boat demo. Like we mentioned in the last announcement, we only get to participate in one Next Fest per game so this is it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/08c36e12590c713c7a80362857700780cdfabb8c.gif[/img]

Additionally, we have tweaked how the skippers work in the racing chapter. There's still more to be done, but we think it's in a very good place at the moment, so please enjoy!

notes.title: Space Boat is at PAX West and coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello space travelers!

It has been a crazy couple of months again, but we have quite a bit of news today.

First off: We're heading to PAX West in Seattle on September 1st to the 4th. Stop by booth 3030 if you're in the neighborhood and come say hello!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/2cad65d4d075617831c5fef503953924e1e9c781.png[/img]

We've been hard at work to bring the Space Boat demo to as many platforms as possible. As of last week, the demo is running on [b]Steam[/b], [b]Steam Deck[/b], [b]Xbox One[/b], [b]Xbox Series X/S[/b], [b]PS4[/b], and [b]PS5[/b]! All that leaves is Nintendo Switch and despite having it running on a devkit for a while now, we haven't been able to find a way to get the demo in the hands of players for free. We're still in talks with Nintendo to see if we can find a compromise. For now though, we're very happy with this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/c4a17e02588cc3f0c509ead92a1a295c29f1aca6.png[/img]

We've been waiting for the right moment to launch our Kickstarter campaign, and we now have a tentative date of October 10th. Please consider getting notified when we go live since it helps us a lot.  Even if you don't pledge later, it helps us with the kickstarter algorithm.

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/spaceboat/space-boat-an-intergalactic-adventure

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/4ad1d1df260c62ff8cd3d4d0671d3acd318806ae.png[/img]

The final bit of news that we have for you today is that we have a brand new webpage. Have a look and let us know what you think:

https://spaceboat.ca/home/


Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: Space Boat's new intro video
notes.content:
Hello space travelers!

It's been a minute since our last update but what's important is that we have a lot to talk about. 

We are proud to announce that Space Boat now has a fancy new video at the start of the game. For those of you who remember walking into computer stores and seeing games running their intro video on a 30 second timer loop, know that Space Boat does exactly that until you start a chapter. 

[previewyoutube=bhNsCplKHS4;full][/previewyoutube]

Big thanks to Sam Shandley for composing this great theme song and hats off to Michelle Franklin for her lyrics and performance.

Additionally, we were able to leverage the power of Unreal Engine 5 for this video by using their global illumination system "Lumen". All of our neon signs became sources of light! Neat! Never thought we'd be capturing in real-time what used to take hours to render.

We also introduced a new character. Say hello to Pepper-oh-noes Mike!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/d6553121a6639ebf2f41c2ad49477f8f125925b6.gif[/img]

What's more, is that for a few weeks we've been working on getting the game working on objectively the most difficult platform: the Nintendo Switch. The good news here is that we managed to get it to run at a steady 30 fps at all times and the optimizations made there is also spilling over to Steam and Steamdeck (although the performance here was already solid after the last round of optimizations).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/77952ac8790118cb08c4ce624bb49791bd7d8efc.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned for more news soon,

Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: Space Boat Valentine's Day edition!
notes.content:
Hello space travelers!

Happy Valentine's day from everyone here at Recombobulator Games! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/2174126dbb12344193eddf0addb3398f6b4bb645.jpg[/img]

The latest version of the demo now includes photo-mode and it features a number of fun filters and overlays. In fact, this Valentine's card is a direct screengrab from the game! We hope you enjoy taking photos on the Jelly Shore and we look forward to seeing what you can do with this new mode!

Wait, how do you activate photo-mode? Well, we could have buried it in the main menu but that's no fun. Instead, we created a hotkey for you to press anytime you feel the need to capture the moment. We won't tell you what it is because we also added a new character to the game that introduces you to the selfie-drone. Be on the lookout for Quartermaster Ned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/6cc19ae35f5c91f7db813058de3f3a3edaf29503.png[/img]

Ned is a special character because his voice and general concept was created in the early 90's! It has been a thrill to bring him to life and pull him out of old films made on camcorders and Corel Show. We hope you like him!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/ec8c91dd709c9c553da17643ba976c2c5f9825c8.jpg[/img]

Special Note: Steam's dedicated button for taking screenshots is F12 (in case you've never taken one). On Xbox and PlayStation it's the share button. Happy photo taking!


Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: Exploring the Jelly Shore sewers
notes.content:
Hello space travelers!
A couple of weeks ago we announced that we are going to be adding quite a bit of content to the Space Boat demo for this coming Holiday season. One of those additions is a whole new game mode that we call “Final Boarding Call Racing” and we figured we’d give you some deets on it.
The first leg of the race will take place in the Jelly Shore sewers. Since Space Boat is always colorful and vibrant, the sewers presented a bit of a challenge for us. We figured there’s a whole rainbow of color in grease stains and radioactive sauces, so we went in that direction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/abd8ad3025346466d421d14a293de4f578e02375.png[/img]

Some of you might have noticed that we added a Lenny’s sign on the exterior of the new I.G.C.L. Princess Andromeda ship. Turns out they’re also one of the official sponsors for FBC Racing. What not many people know is that Lenny’s is a restaurant for a race of coprophagians (think space flies). If you played Elden Ring, then you shouldn’t be surprised with the concept of dung eaters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/af0812e0194a6b038d3716ee0b7f3ec910f310fa.png[/img]

Lenny’s mascot is named “Swirly Pops”. What’s that? Yes, his tooth is a piece of corn. No, I don’t see a problem here. Anyhow, we can’t wait to make some emoticons with him.
Expect obstacles such as piles of suitcases and leftover kegs of Lenny’s Special Sauce. The sauce is so thick and radioactive that skippers have trouble going through it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/165155f4eeb11a827617aaf6fc1039adddb7e959.gif[/img]

We are currently in the process of tweaking how fast the skipper goes, how strong the boost is, what the best angle for the ramps are, and so on. Our focus remains making it fun to race.
For the next newsletter, we’re hoping to have some news on the second leg of the race as well as some info on what lives in the sewers…


Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: Bigger and Better Demo!
notes.content:
HELLO SPACE TRAVELERS! 

We hope you’re having a great week. It’s been a minute since our last newsletter/announcement, so it was time to have a little update.

Not going to lie, it’s been tough for our little team recently as we got smaller, but we’re committed to bringing you a beefy DEMO update this Holiday season. Not only are there new characters, investigation mechanics, and a camera mode, but we also have a new section that has racing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/0d9eceae8bd86c4184f14352000c68b5d8e38906.jpg[/img]

We call it “FBC” Racing which stands for “Final Boarding Call Racing". For those of you that completed the demo, you might remember (spoilers for those that didn’t complete it) that we ended in the sewers with a premium skipper and we were on our way to the I.G.C.L. Princess Andromeda. Well, turns out there’s an underground unsanctioned racing group that has been waiting for the final boarding call so they can start their race. FBC racing was originally created by bored billionaires with nothing better to do, but it evolved into a well-organized racing event with announcers and sponsorships!

We hope you’ll enjoy this new mode! We’re also hoping that we can have it available on PS4/PS5 and not just Steam and Xbox this time around!

We would love to know what you think of our plans for the Holiday season. Please come tour [url=https://spaceboat.ca/discord]Discord [/url]if you haven’t already and let us know!

Recombobulator Games signing off!

notes.title: ALL THE SPACE BOAT LORE!
notes.content:
Oh hey, Passengers! 

As promised in a few newsletters back, it’s time for a deep dive into Space Boat’s inspiration and lore! 
So keep reading for all our juicy secrets and a new graphic!! 

Why would space travel be treated any differently than anything else humanity has been involved with?
The Space Boat universe was developed in the 80s and 90s, during a time when the thirst for Sci-Fi was at an all-time high. Franchises like Star Trek and Star Wars coloured the popular landscape, and though both have different ways of looking at humanity’s possible future, Space Boat takes a more cynical and satirical view of the future: If humanity had developed an easy method for interstellar space travel, it would capitalize and trivialize it, converting the miracle of space travel into commercial transportation.
Underneath the colorful, fun, and goofy exterior, there’s the beating heart of a true Sci-Fi.

While updating the I.G.C.L. Princess Andromeda, much care was taken to answer underlying technology that exists in this whacky universe. We came up with some ideas that we think Isaac Asimov would be proud of like: Artificial atmosphere. In most Sci-Fi shows, oxygen is treated simply like it is on current day space stations while gravity is thrown in like “future space magic”. Sometimes you get Babylon 5 levels of ingenuity where they spin a ship to create artificial gravity while sometimes you get the Wall-E treatment where people are somehow thrown around a ship depending on the ship’s orientation. Seeing that we wanted to allow people to vacation on the exterior of the ship while in space, we wondered if we could have a legitimate scientific approach to having an oxygen environment without being in an airtight structure. It turns out the answer was gravity all along. After all, the earth does not have a dome and somehow maintains it’s atmosphere from going into space. In the Space Boat universe, you can not only take a stroll on the outside of the ship while star gazing with the naked eye, but you can also swim in outdoor pools and take a ride in water parks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/323aec5611022d59ae95454f16c9707c88bb4eb6.png[/img]


Thanks for reading, and until next week!

notes.title: The New Lady Of Space Boat! ⚓
notes.content:
Happy Friday, Passengers! 

It’s your weekly Space Boat update, and it’s time to show you more of our development! 

It’s time to meet the new lady of Space Boat! 

Princess Andromeda! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/50a6f403b7aba147619d51eae496c8fd9ecd463a.png[/img]


[b]Wanna see her Spin? Let’s do it! WEEEEEEEEEEE[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/611ef10573a6780ed7230c49d4c0fdc16e0dcb4f.gif[/img]

Here’s some lore on Princess Andromeda and how she will be involved in the Boat design and the game! 
A mascot dressed as Princess Andromeda walks around the boat to entertain the young and unsuspecting, much like a certain other theme park has its princesses walking around. 
A Rugatarian female is 3x the size of a male, so “Princess Andromeda” might accidentally knock a few kids around. 

Whilst on the boat, you can blow the horn that Princess Andromeda is seen holding. The horn sounds like an 80’s jingle and is designed to burrow into and embed itself into your subconscious. 
“Release the Kraken of space travel!” is Space Boat’s slogan. In the original mythology with Perseus, Andromeda never blew the horn, but Space Boat’s marketing crew has purposely appropriated the myth to meet their corporate needs. The ship’s overall design tells this story and reminds passengers of the ad just by looking at it. 

Rugatarians are also like glow worms (if anyone remembers that), so they might surprise you in the dark.


We hope you like her and can’t wait to add her to the game; she’s going to make a splash! 


-Lauren

notes.title: An important update on Space Boat
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/9be76413ba5bb4db52bdbaf2b1bffa0680a8b1e3.png[/img]

I went into Ray Gretz this morning and found Earl this way. I have no idea why the gift is not in the usual "storage" space. I took a picture and decided to investigate at a later date.


So, we're are at the end of our campaign and the results are looking like what we talked about during the last update, i.e.: nowhere near our initial goal. In a way I'm relieved we didn't just hit the goal, because there are a number of stretch goals that would make the game a whole lot better. Let's be real though, not making the initial goal is not great. However, like I mentioned last time we're not in a bad place. We have a great community, something secret coming up in December, and a chance to run a better campaign at a later date. Please stay tuned for a post-campaign update that will have all the details.


Just because the campaign ended, doesn't mean the fun stops. If you haven't already, follow our Twitter page for more animated gifs and pics or join our discord for some rather disturbing theories about Earl and Glenn.


Wishlist Space Boat and join our Discord because this is just the beginning of this Space Boat adventure.

notes.title: Space Boat enters week #4 of its campaign.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/327f0ca555a18f60562097e6278f8258f755f8d0.png[/img]



Say hello to our spectral barista: ghastly Glenn. If you hear someone making espresso in the middle of the night, just be glad he didn't ask for a subscription.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/d37fc3574b4c8cac0c2b5ab34bad575220848ae9.gif[/img]

It's been a crazy week for us.  Something very big happened that made us stop everything that we were doing for patch 0.20.2  so we could work on it. Unfortunately, we can't tell you what it is (due to N.D.A.s), but I think you'll want to keep an eye on us for the next couple of months. 


I also wanted to take a moment and talk about the elephant in the room which is that we are far from our initial goal and that we only have 9 days to go. If we end the campaign unsuccessfully, I thought it's only fair to explain what our plans are:

We will probably run another Kickstarter campaign and use what we have learned from this one.  We hope to have a post-campaign update that will include a pre-launch link to a new campaign. Please keep an eye out for that update. Note: your pledge won't be charged unless we make the initial goal, so you have nothing to lose.

The big thing that we can't talk about, will help us tremendously with this new campaign.  
There's another even bigger thing (that once again we can't talk about), that is still to be determined. This alone might help make Space Boat possible, but we're keeping our expectations low since it is not a given.

There are other funding groups that we have approached that might help us because Space Boat has garnered a lot of attention from Streamers and podcasters.

Overall, we're not in a bad position, despite our Kickstarter results. A wonderful community has been growing steadily that is wholesome and positive. We have had quite a few streamers enjoy our demo and we have seen nothing but encouragement from all of you. This has been the silver lining to our crowdfunding cloud and it has genuinely touched us. 


As always, thank you for your love and support!

notes.title: New Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40047624/9b1226afbd4476db0b579586f9b0964c12f45138.gif[/img]

Patch notes 

* Added music and voice volume control for Streamers to adjust volumes in-game.
* Added a much-anticipated interaction and cinematic involving Dale in the hangar. 
* Added a tutorial cone right before the electrical obstacle course to help players out.
* Added interactions for Space Chuck's sugar station and waste bins.
* Added small interaction for Cuckoo Cola machines.
* Added event that makes Dale turn his back and stop talking to you after you get the boarding pass.
* Added Vista voice lines to the outdoor Jelly Shore area.
* Fixed exploit with a collision in starting zone. No more fun for 99HealingPotions and Radders will be able to complete the Demo now.
* Fixed player movement while in opening cinematic. Thanks again 99HealingPotions.
* Fixed sliding doors at Ray Gretz and Space Chuck's from looking like a poltergeist possessed them when the framerate is low.
* Fixed icon display when using mouse and keyboard.
* Fixed mouse mode camera control when starting upper vents.
* Fixed SteamVR from being activated.
* Fixed an issue with tutorial cones previewing 2 objects at once.
* Fixed feature with the jelly dog that was perceived as a bug when spamming interact.
* Fixed NPCs on the boardwalk from getting stuck and leaving conversations while still active.
* Fixed cat-form collision to avoid getting stuck in things or putting head through pipes.
* Fixed collision exploit in Space Chuck's vents. No more skipping the area, Mr. 99HealingPotions.
* Removed tail collision since it would get caught in the electrical obstacle course and people would complain.
